cond_0423.responsibilities:
Key Accountabilities
Coordinates with customers and internal teams to research and resolve complicated issues, providing detailed analysis, explanations and reconciliations on contract information
Reviews, discusses and explains products, services, contractual terms and conditions, billing policies and payment options
Responds to service requests, monitors transactions and works as a liaison between the customer and the Transmission and Distribution Utility companies
Facilitates contract changes including amendments and location additions and deletions
Works simultaneously in multiple systems, databases, office programs and online solutions including but not limited to SAP, Access, Excel, various online repositories
Supports the extended sales teams on bids and customer issues when necessary – including attending client meetings and sales pitches
Shares accountability for assigned monthly risk controls, monitoring and reporting on them regularly
Works cross-functionally with Sales, Analytics, Billing, Marketing and Revenue Operations to help ensure high performance standards and service goals are being met
Coordinates with relevant stakeholders to negotiate, approve and/or recommend billing adjustments, credits, waivers etc… after conducting thorough analysis and in accordance with corporate Delegation of Authority processes
Key Metrics
Timely resolution of customer inquiries, in adherence with SL metrics
Customer Satisfaction; measure through customer feedback surveys
Professional communication
Delivery of quality customer experiences
Consistent learning and skill development
Follows all company, legal and regulatory guidelines in response to customer issues
cond_0423.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
2+ Years experience providing verbal and written customer support
Strong analytical, mathematical and problem solving skills
Strong verbal and written communication skills, including superior skills interacting with customers
Ability to analyze and resolve complex customer issues/cases independently
Strong decision-making and negotiating skills
High school diploma or equivalent
Proficiency with MS Office tools
Preferred Requirements
Strong understanding of market-related transactions; [Location masked] Electric Market and ERCOT
SAP experience
Experience gained through college degree programs, certifications, or equivalent
Self-motivated with flexibility and ability to adapt to frequent change
cond_0423.values: We value delivering results to a high standard and taking pride in work done well. We aim to be defined by quality, consistency, and strong performance.
